== Summary ==
Normalized image from the Google document ''Reflections Gold Remastered'', described in [[Reflections Gold#How the copies survived|Reflections Gold]]. Card face resized proportionally and centered on a black border with transparent rounded corners. Dimensions: 745 × 1039 pixels. Historical reconstruction; its original resolution was 391 × 569 pixels.
